records.title: Humidity after the typhoon
records.summary: After a typhoon, relative humidity in the Silk Reeling Mill reaches 88 % and rises: mould risk to the wooden trusses TR-201 to TR-204 and the reeling machines.

steps.text: The typhoon passed overnight; HS-301 by the north windows reads above 79 % RH and climbing. Above 65 % for days, mould starts on the king-post trusses TR-201 to TR-204 and the reeling machines.

issue.summary: HS-301 reads {value} % RH in the Silk Reeling Mill against the 65 % preservation limit and is rising after the typhoon.
HS-301 at {value} % RH and rising; mould risk to the wooden trusses TR-201 to TR-204 and the reeling machines RM-101 to RM-106.

steps.text: Steward, Tomioka Silk Mill: HS-301 reads {value} % RH in the Silk Reeling Mill and rising after the typhoon. Decision: start dehumidifier DH-1101 and close the north windows, then check the trusses for mould. Reply STARTED or CALL.

Conservation notice (synthetic demo): relative humidity in the Silk Reeling Mill is above the 65 % preservation limit.
